<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import collections
def dots(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    c = collections.Counter(((r-9)//6,(c2-7)//6) for r in range(9,60) for c2 in range(7,60) if a[r][c2] in ('N','g'))
    return {k:v for k,v in c.items()}
def pur(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c] in ('p','P')]
    return bool(cells)
def orange(fr):
    a = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return a[34][33]
print("start:", dots(current_frame), "purple:", pur(current_frame), "orange:", orange(current_frame))
seq = [({'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':14}, "sel(1,1)"),
       ({'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':26}, "click(1,3)"),
       ({'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':26}, "sel(1,3)"),
       ({'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':38}, "click(1,5)"),
       ({'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':44}, "sel(1,6)"),
       ({'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':32}, "click(1,4)"),
       ({'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':33}, "click ORANGE"),
       ({'action':'MOUSE','row':16,'col':32}, "click gray top dot(1,4)"),
       ({'action':'MOUSE','row':52,'col':44}, "click bottom dot(7,6)")]
for act, name in seq:
    action([act])
    print(name, dots(current_frame), "purple:", pur(current_frame), "orange:", orange(current_frame))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("STOP: level done"); break
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
